species: Raw files were searched against the human National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Refseq protein database (updated on 04-07-2013, 32,015 entries) by Mascot 2.3 (Matrix Science Inc) implemented on Proteome Discoverer 1.4 (Thermo Scientific).
tissue: A proteomic landscape of diffuse-type gastric cancer
disease_state: The diffuse-type gastric cancer (DGC) is a subtype of gastric cancer with the worst prognosis and few treatment options.
sample_source: Extracted proteins from frozen tissues were digested with trypsin and the resulting peptides were separated at high pH with small columns packed in pipette tips (sRP); fractionated peptides were pooled to 6 MS runs using a 75 min high-performance liquid chromatography gradient at low pH.
anatomic_site_tumor: A proteomic landscape of diffuse-type gastric cancer
